label: scam
source_name: Companies House, GOV.UK guidance 'Reporting scams pretending to be from Companies House'
published: 2019-02 (date in the email; page last updated 2026-07-16)
text:
GOV.UK
HM Revenue & Customs
Verify your identity by Friday, Feb 8
You are getting this email because Companies House needs to verify your identity by Friday, February 8, 2019 at 10:09am GMT.
If you don't verify your identity, your company account will be put on hold. To confirm your identity, click this link:
/verify-your-company/post-sign-in
notes: Page caption: 'Email featuring the HMRC logo telling you that Companies House needs to verify your identity'.
